verdict.rationale: LM Studio exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API and a headless mode (llmster) explicitly designed for servers/CI, plus MCP server support, all of which let coding agents use it as a backend; community members confirm this works ("OpenAI server makes it really easy to spin up a server and test", "headless LM Studio flow makes local inference usable from real tools"). However, hands-on feedback also notes friction—MCP agentic use got stuck in loops and felt unpolished, and earlier versions lacked a true daemon mode without the Electron UI—so it delivers but with real caveats.
